{{Quote|Your visit is my privilege.|translated=1|Sergeant Geph greets a customer|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Geph''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] who served as a [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] in the [[Republic Army|army]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Galactic War]] against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].<ref name="TOR" /> In [[3640 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR dates|4}}</ref> he was stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]] while a [[Battle of Ilum|battle]] that took place there. During the battle, Geph sold weapons from a stall in the [[Republic base camp]]. While at the stall, he wore [[Color/Legends|white]] [[Armor/Legends|armor]] without a helmet. Geph had red [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and skin and no [[Hair/Legends|hair]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Geph appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], as a Weapons Vendor for Republic players on Ilum.<ref name="TOR" /> With the release of Game Update 4.0 on [[October 20]], [[2015]],<ref name="4.0">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/10202015/game-update-4.0-knights-fallen-empire-early-access|text=Game Update 4.0: Knights of the Fallen Empire Early Access Patch Notes}}</ref> Geph was removed from the game along with the rest of the Weapons Vendors.<ref name="TOR" /> His position is also marked on a map in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Explorer's Guide]]'', a game guide released by [[Prima Games]].<ref name="Explorer">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Explorer's Guide]]''</ref>
